payload.entry: -r record perf breakdown before choosing fix

payload.text:
perf profile breakdown (code inspection + attempt-28 runner medians), recorded before choosing the fix.

Gate-open Reading paint path for a catalog host (projects 64 rows; records 106 rows):
1. Obsidian renders the stored callout natively (unavoidable; the gate-closed inline baseline pays this too).
2. The kind's inline Reading painter decorates the native callout synchronously in its
   Markdown postprocessor (priorities 51-53: albums 51, records 52, projects 53, areas similar).
   Cost scales with row count (per-row DOM work over 64/106 rows).
3. The property-card host postprocessor (priority 46/47) batches via setTimeout(0), then
   paintReading mounts the card synchronously: foot build + propertyCardCabinetsAssemble
   (provider applies checks are sync, cached reports) + onMounted claims + Reading
   absorption hides the native callout.
4. The default-open body builds async: propertyCardCabinetRenderCatalog runs a SECOND
   full MarkdownRenderer.render of the same region source plus the same painter again,
   then binds links/hover. The body cache never helps across opens (a body inside another
   mount's container is not orphaned, so the fresh mount re-renders).
5. measureCatalogPaint stops the clock when cabinet-body li rows exist.

Attempt-28 medians (gate open vs inline): Projects 146-147ms vs 65-70ms (2.1-2.25x);
album 127-138ms vs 65-69ms (1.84-2.12x). Cabinet ~= inline + (inline painter + card
mount/stack + body re-render + body paint). The inline painter pass (step 2) is pure
waste under an open gate: its output is hidden by absorption in the same frame (each
painter already paint-then-strips when it sees a mounted stack). Removing it shortens
the measured window by the full painter cost with no new work added.

Chosen fix (plan candidate 1): defer the inline Reading painter for the measured kinds
(projects, records) when the gate is open on an eligible Reading surface. Skip the
synchronous paint; keep widget tracking; one bounded fallback timer (150ms, max 3
re-arms) paints the native callout only if no cabinet absorption covers it by then
(never-claimed, claim failed/released, card never mounted). Live Preview untouched.
Fail-open preserved: every path that shows the stored section paints it exactly as
today, only slightly later; plus 240wj failure branches now call a repaintNative hook
threaded from the kind providers (existing schedule*Refresh loops) so a failed body
still leaves today's painted catalog visible. No 240c surface/retry changes
(reading-miss owns that); no stored-byte or vault-format changes.

payload.entry: perf profile (CDP Profiler + performance.mark timelines inside the real runner, athena): the projects 50-74ms long task was NOT the Reading body render. A Reading leaf keeps its Live Preview editor loaded but hidden (.markdown-source-view display:none); on every open the hidden editor built the full card and rendered the Projects cabinet body through MarkdownRenderer (~40-45ms) before Obsidian rendered the preview. Other costs on the window: propertyCardCabinetHostDigest (paintKey) applied all four kinds and stable-stringified every full report ~16x per open; the earlier inline-paint deferral never applied because Obsidian post-processes Reading sections detached (el.closest fails), so the native callout was always painted and the Reading body re-rendered it (records ~16-20ms). Also found: the Records body never tagged its Reading absorption (claim ran while the card was detached and onOpen re-claimed with no scope), so album Reading showed the stored Records section twice (same on clean master).

perf fix (bob-ledger-tools 1.172.9, rebased on bob-plugins 4dd95d52): (1) 240wl deferWhileHidden: an opted-in provider body (host catalogs) in a hidden Live Preview editor builds only when IntersectionObserver sees its panel; records keeps its claim but defers the render the same way. (2) 241al digest memo keyed by source + per-kind report-state identity. (3) 240wd deferral eligibility answers detached sections through ctx.containerEl (embed/popover/card-body containers never defer) and only for area/project (projects) or album (records) frontmatter types; detached-at-fire sections get the bounded retries. (4) 240wj Reading bodies clone the unpainted native callout (Reading-only list chrome stripped) instead of a second MarkdownRenderer pass; painted/embed/mismatched/detached falls back to render. (5) Records Reading claim tags via the host Reading scope (album header threads readingScope) and onOpen keeps a live tagged Reading claim. New tests: scripts/test-ledger-tools-cabinets-reading-paint.cjs (12), cabinets-perf (11, ctx frontmatter added). Focused suites 133/133; npm test 10307/10313 with only test-snooze-model-vectors failing, which fails identically on clean 4dd95d52; build:check + docs inventory clean; bob plugins sync deployed 1.172.9.

perf evidence, unmodified runner on athena, 1.172.9: run1 album cab 117/inl 69 (1.70x) projects 107/62 (1.73x), no cabinet long tasks, 99 pass/1 fail; run2 album 109/65 (1.68x) projects 109/59 (1.85x), no cabinet long tasks, 99 pass/1 fail; 0 runtime exceptions, 0 console errors both runs. Both perf-* checks PASS in both runs. The one failure in each run is keys-reading-pick-overlay-lists-numbered-kinds, which also fails on the clean master 4dd95d52 control (that control also fails projects perf 143/68, 2.10x). Earlier runs of an intermediate build (before the records hidden-editor deferral) were noisier: one album 187/73 (two 50-90ms long tasks) and one projects 131/65 (2.02x). Evidence: run1 file:explicit:b29439ea2b9eecb93bc313ee, run2 file:explicit:6f2132b1212738d3a422cce5, run2 shots file:explicit:ccb420b8ac54123b122fc74e, clean control file:explicit:b003208183d954bfcc1f66ec, mark timelines file:explicit:99309d341ce63ec6d8668bdf.
